Frictions the infra driver hit on 2026-09-25 (session f61e590b). Each is a small defect with a concrete reproduction.

1. **Review asks misreport success.** `ask-codex --review --branch …` and `ask-agy --review --branch …` printed a complete verdict (`VERDICT: REQUEST_CHANGES` / `APPROVE`, model, SHA) and then `ask-<lane> review dispatch did not complete: status='no_deliverable'`, exit 1 (tasks review-8500-r1, review-ulif-r1). A read-only review has no branch deliverable by design; the wrapper should judge a review by its verdict, not by a push.
2. **`ask-deepseek` has no review path.** `ask-deepseek - --review --branch X` → `error: unrecognized arguments: --review --branch`. `ask-codex`/`ask-kimi`/`ask-claude`/`ask-agy` accept them. Model-assignment lists DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as a formal code-review seat.
3. **`--background` on asks is retired** (`legacy ask --background is retired; enqueue through fleet-comms`) but the drive-epic skill never says how to run a review ask without blocking the driver.
4. **Worker commits onto its base branch.** `impl-8652-r2` (cursor) was dispatched with `--base cursor/impl-8652`; it committed onto `cursor/impl-8652` instead of `cursor/impl-8652-r2`, so delegate reported `no_deliverable` while the work existed.
5. **Driver verification worktrees.** A plain `git worktree add --detach` review checkout is a full 1.6 GB checkout (sparse only via delegate), and `review-*`-named ones get reaped by the hygiene sweep while in use. There is no supported "verify this head" helper.
6. **Write guard `$VAR` false positives** (#8500) — hit ~6 times; fix in flight.
7. **Dead session scratch** — a 7.7 GB scratch dir of a session that ended 2026-09-24 stayed in `/tmp/claude-1000/`; tracked in #8783.
